title: Reduce repeated disk parsing for missing-index test-run wait identity checks
outcome: Missing-index identity checks read only the request and canonical locator where feasible, preserving all pinned identity and unsupported-replacement semantics, and repeated canonicalization failures have an explicit bounded retry-cost policy.
acceptance: The gone check preserves changed-runId, unsupported-request, native-locator, request digest and pinned fingerprint rejection and matching-original reindex grace.
A request-only path avoids parsing results.json when checking a missing-index wait, with relevant regression evidence.
Repeated canonicalization failures have a documented and tested retry/cost policy without weakening ownership or substitution fences.
